question: Is AuroraPIC's lower above-15.8-eV population caused by a lower unconditional promotion rate, a higher demotion rate, or different collision-resolved losses?

basis.prior_result: Tail-conditioned persistence, turnover, and collision histories were nearly identical even though AuroraPIC's energetic population fraction was about 13 percent lower.
basis.native_pilot_observed_before_declaration: Seed 13507 was run only for diagnostic passivity and population qualification. It contained 474588776 critical electron-timesteps, 4610 interstep promotions, and 4503 interstep demotions. No AuroraPIC crossing output or other native seed was observed before this rule was declared.
basis.interpretive_limit: Interstep crossings compare consecutive synchronized pre-collision states and therefore include the net effect of the prior collision stage plus the following field push. Separately reported collision crossings are before/after accepted-collision events and are not an additive partition of interstep crossings.

prospective_decision_rule.promotion_limited_supported_if: AuroraPIC/native interstep-promotion rate per million electron-steps is at most 0.90
prospective_decision_rule.demotion_enhanced_supported_if: AuroraPIC/native interstep-demotion rate per million electron-steps is at least 1.10
prospective_decision_rule.collision_loss_difference_supported_if: AuroraPIC/native excitation- or ionization-collision demotion rate per million electron-steps differs from unity by at least 0.15
prospective_decision_rule.birth_supply_difference_supported_if: AuroraPIC/native subthreshold-birth rate per million electron-steps differs from unity by at least 0.15, or energetic-birth rates differ with at least 100 energetic births in every member
prospective_decision_rule.native_repeatability_gate: relative three-seed range no greater than 0.15 for occupancy, interstep promotion, interstep demotion, and subthreshold birth rates; no greater than 0.30 for elastic, excitation, and ionization collision-demotion rates
prospective_decision_rule.null_interpretation: If all gates pass and no threshold is crossed, unconditional threshold traffic does not localize the tail deficit; the next test must resolve field-work increments and collision-stage energy changes more finely.

implementation_difference_to_record: Native eduPIC permits ionization secondaries appended during the collision loop to be considered later in the same timestep; AuroraPIC freezes the initial particle count. The energetic-birth and collision-transition columns expose possible consequences without changing either algorithm.
claim_boundary: This compares one deterministic four-cycle AuroraPIC continuation with three deterministic four-cycle native eduPIC continuations of independently equilibrated states. It is a one-case code-to-code mechanism diagnostic, not experimental validation, a proof of code-wide correctness, or unrestricted uncertainty quantification.
